item.name: 3. Gemini AI - PR Proof-of-Fix & Security Audit

body.raw:
{
  "bountyId": "bounty-104",
  "prTitle": "fix(auth): clear session cache references to eliminate SSR memory leak",
  "contributorName": "Marcus Vance",
  "contributorEmail": "marcus.dev@fastmail.com",
  "diffContent": "diff --git a/src/auth.ts b/src/auth.ts\n@@ -88,6 +88,10 @@\n+ if (sessionCache.has(sessionId)) { sessionCache.delete(sessionId); }\n+ global.gc?.();"
